hypotheses.justification: This instance is automatically included but unnecessary. The definition of nGL uses AutomorphicForm.unipotentGL2, which requires only a commutative ring and has underlying matrix definitionally !![1, x; 0, 1]. The tensor-product ring structure needs [Field L] and [Algebra K L], not [NumberField L]. Thus `omit [NumberField L] in` leaves the statement well-formed and the same `rfl` proof works. The identity holds for every x, including zero, without any finiteness assumption on L.
